newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodia's Pol Pot has left northern base - premier.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia's Pol Pot has left northern base - premier.

text.p: Khmer Rouge leader Pol Pot has abducted the guerrilla movement's nominal leader and left his northern stronghold of Anlong Veng with 200 fighters, Cambodia's first prime minister said on Friday.

"The day before yesterday he (Pol Pot) arrested (nominal leader) Khieu Samphan and escaped Anlong Veng with 200 troops. Pol Pot is ill, he could not walk by himself, but he was carried by his men with a sling," co-premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh told reporters. He did not say where Pol Pot had gone.

The notorious Pol Pot, who led the Khmer Rouge during its disastrous "killing fields" rule over Cambodia from 1975 to early 1979, was rumoured this week to have left Cambodia for Bangkok en route to political exile in China.
Chinese foreign ministry officials on Thursday denied Pol Pot was in China and said he would not be given asylum in the country.
